title: ME/CFS mechanisms and treatment
bottleneck: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome disables millions with post-exertional malaise as its hallmark, yet has no diagnostic biomarker, no FDA-approved treatment, and a history of psychosomatic dismissal that starved it of research funding.
why_it_blocks: Patients endure profound disability with essentially no medical options: one of medicine's starkest neglects, now echoed in Long COVID.
current_state: Post-pandemic research funding has increased, with studies probing immune, metabolic, and vascular mechanisms. No disease-modifying therapy exists. The parallels with Long COVID have finally brought scientific attention and funding, with shared mechanisms under investigation. Yet decades of neglect mean the field is starting from a thin evidence base, and patients continue to wait for the first approved therapy. Diagnostic criteria based on post-exertional malaise are improving trial design, but validated biomarkers remain elusive.
